options.name: inherits_from
options.description: Default existing base role names to inherit permissions from. Can be overridden per item. Each listed role must exist and must not be part of the same batch.

options.name: items
options.description: Roles to manage. Each item uses the same role-specific fields as C(cybus.connectware.role).

options.name: max_concurrent
options.description: Maximum number of role operations to run concurrently. This limits worker threads in this module. The Connectware auth service is typically the bottleneck under parallel load; increase this value only after validating auth service load.

options.name: permission_mode
options.description: Default for how I(permissions) is interpreted when I(inherits_from) is set. Can be overridden per item. See the C(cybus.connectware.role) module for the semantics of C(exact), C(additive) and C(subtractive).

options.name: permissions
options.description: Default list of permissions for all items. Can be overridden per item (not merged; the item list replaces the default). When omitted, the module leaves current role permissions unchanged. Set to an empty list to remove all permissions.

options.name: state
options.description: Default target state for Connectware Roles. Can be overridden per item.

options.name: target_hostname
options.description: Used to connect to the Connectware API.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Flag to enable Connectware certificate checking.
